key_insight: This Perspective proposes Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS) that share structured reasoning experiences across institutions rather than raw data or model parameters.
clinical_relevance: DAS could help medical AI learn from diverse institutional experiences and adapt to longitudinal patient care, but clinical benefits remain unproven.
method: Connect distributed AI agents across healthcare institutions.
Exchange abstracted trajectories of observations, hypotheses, tool use, and outcome feedback.
Aggregate reasoning experiences to build collective clinical intelligence.
evidence_signal: The abstract presents a conceptual framework and discusses deployment and governance; it reports no datasets, empirical evaluations, or clinical outcomes.
watch_item: Sharing reasoning trajectories requires safeguards against disclosure of sensitive patient information.
paper_title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
